title: scope sub-change-map schema
question: scope阶段产出的sub-change-map.md的schema是什么
resolution: sub-change-map.md是scope阶段可选产物。schema: YAML frontmatter含sub-changes数组,每项id(SC-030-NN)/name(kebab-case)/goal(一句话)/dependsOn(依赖ID数组)/status(pending|planning|implementing|verifying|merged)。无子变更时不出此文件(向后兼容)。AI在scope阶段分析spec+scope后提议划分,用户确认后落盘
